notes.title: Update 1.0 (New Character, Improvements, GORE, & More!!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone this is Developer and Publisher Matt Sowards,
I am back with updates for Matt's Project Zombies Endless this is the first official update I believe for my game and I hope you all enjoy the improvements and fixes and additions added to the game.
Yes this is early access so there may be bugs but if theres anything you find please just report it to me directly or on discord or the forums, I'll fix it no problem.

Changelog:
- Added a female survivor playable character
- Made lighting improvements to all the maps
- Made gameplay improvements to Map 1
- New animations for zombies, attacks, runs, walks, and more.
- New sounds for zombies, attacks, hurt, shot, impacts and more
- New HUD for killing and shooting zombies
- Random Weapon box fixed on Map 1
- Random Weapon Wall Buys added on Map 1
- Improvements made to the games performance
- Music Easter Eggs Collectables added to Map 1 (Star and Rubber Duck)
- Two new songs added to the game.
- Female Jumping sounds added to the female playable character.


Update HOTFIX 
- Fixed some visual glitches
- Fixed some bugs with AI
- Fixed some bugs with settings saving
- Changed logo to new logo on main menu
+ More various fixes.

Update HOTFIX 2 (Added at 6:49 pm Est.)
- Completely overhauled the lighting on Map 1 (Decayed House), new skybox, realistic lighting
- New [BETA] Dynamic Weather System on Map 1 (Decayed House)
+ Many more bug fixes for this update.
